pasCherFaq.q: Do I have to pay online to book?
pasCherFaq.a: No — no online payment is ever requested. You send your request from the website, an adviser confirms the details with you by phone or WhatsApp, and the booking is then finalised with a written contract signed at our Casablanca agency, with an official receipt.

pasCherFaq.q: How do I get the lowest price?
pasCherFaq.a: The lowest fares usually go with shared rooms, quadruple or quintuple, and with departures outside the Ramadan period. Also compare the tiers offered on each programme: the economy tier relies on hotels a little further from the Haram, which noticeably lowers the price per person.

pasCherFaq.q: What does the displayed price include?
pasCherFaq.a: Each programme details exactly what the price includes — flight, hotels, transfers and guidance — and what it does not, on its own page. Prices are in Moroccan dirhams per person and vary with the chosen tier and room type: double, triple, quadruple or quintuple.

ramadanFaq.q: Why is Ramadan Umrah more expensive?
ramadanFaq.a: Demand peaks during Ramadan, especially over the last ten days of the month, so flight prices and near-Haram hotel rates rise accordingly. Booking early and choosing a shared room, quadruple or quintuple, remains the most reliable way to keep the budget under control.

ramadanFaq.q: When should I book Ramadan Umrah?
ramadanFaq.a: As early as possible: seats and hotels near the Haram sell out months ahead, especially for the last ten days. Send your request from the website or on WhatsApp, and an adviser will confirm the real availability of the departure you are interested in.
